title: The Strata That Dreams in Disagreement

features.name: argument-in-stone
features.desc-on-touch: Two layers of bedrock pressing against each other, each convinced it contains the truth. The friction between them has worn a polished edge.

features.name: thought-layer
features.desc-on-touch: This stratum thinks only in crystals and minerals. It disagrees with the thought-layer above it on everything that matters.

features.name: the-seam
features.desc-on-touch: Where disagreement became geological. The line where two arguments decided to remain side-by-side forever, neither winning, both true.

features.name: echo-of-older-arguing
features.desc-on-touch: These layers have been disagreeing so long they have forgotten what they were arguing about. The argument is the only truth left.

features.name: the-unresolved-pressure
features.desc-on-touch: The weight of the sky pressing down on two thoughts that will never reconcile. This pressure has been rising for millions of years.

inscription: the strata dream in parallel — each layer sleeping a different truth, and none of them wake at the same time; this is how the earth stays young

file.name: Competing_Geological_Surveys_1920s_1950s_Marked.pdf
file.note: Overlaid geological surveys from two different decades and teams. They describe the same rock face entirely differently. Both surveyors are dead.

reverie.title: REVERIE — red earth argues with itself at dusk
narr: You sit on the outcrop. Katita traces the seam with
one finger. 'They're both right,' she says. 'The stone
knows this. It keeps them separate so they can both be
true.' You understand suddenly: she is not talking
about geology. The stone does not need to choose.

exits.label: back to the contested strata where arguments age into bedrock
upward to where younger stone has not yet learned to disagree
deeper into stone that has forgotten it was ever young
down to where bedrock still speaks to itself in the old languages
